name: P-008 native control delivery: withheld emission stays Prepared; actual hook emission precedes Applied
command: Verify staging /api/health sha b95c119c84; set this session loop interval from 60 to 61 seconds through loop:arm to create control generation 4.

Import apps/operator/scripts/hooks/inject/core.mjs postInjection; call turn-start for this real SU owner with memoryEnabled:false and confirmedDelivery:null; intentionally do not emit the returned text or commit a delivery ledger token.
Read exact-owner session_briefs, turn-start-control read cursor, and session_identity_activation_events for generation 4 through attributed code:run/dev:pg_query.

Let the next actual Codex turn-start hook emit generation 4. Read its developer-message CTRL line from the native transcript and compare the hook ledger token digest with the pending server cursor digest.

Let the following actual turn-start hook echo its own recorded token. Assert Prepared timestamp < native emission timestamp < Applied timestamp, exact specification/state/native-session equality, and delivered generation 4. No manual token confirmation was sent.
summary: The existing hook transport returned generation-4 content on the current staging build. With emission deliberately withheld, the server kept the generation Prepared and the delivery watermark at 3 with zero generation-4 Applied receipts. A real subsequent Codex hook emitted generation 4 and recorded the matching token. The next actual hook request acknowledged it, writing Applied after the observed native emission and advancing the watermark to 4. This is control-only generation delivery evidence; the selected identity pair did not change.
